description: Compute annual quality, moat, earnings-quality, and capital-allocation metrics for one exact Bullrun ticker from existing financial statements: ROIC, ROE/ROA, ROIC-vs-supplied-WACC, accruals, cash conversion, capex intensity, dividend payout/growth, diluted share-count changes, and a buyback proxy. Read-only.

estimatedWaccPct.description: Optional user-supplied WACC assumption, in percent. When omitted, ROIC-vs-WACC spread is returned as null.

taxRateFallbackPct.description: Fallback tax rate used for NOPAT only when reported tax/pretax data is missing or unusable.

ticker.description: The Bullrun ticker. Use the listing ticker returned by search_stocks. US/European examples: AAPL, BMW, NESN. Most Asian listings keep their exchange suffix (6324.T, 0700.HK); some use bare codes (005930). Native or suffixed forms resolve only when one listing matches; search by company name or ISIN if unsure.

years.description: How many fiscal years of annual history to evaluate.

name: get_quality_moat_metrics
title: Get quality and moat metrics
